title: Cook's first Pacific voyage
summary: James Cook's ship Endeavour observed the transit of Venus at Tahiti, then charted New Zealand and Australia's east coast.
why: Charted New Zealand and eastern Australia for Europeans; Cook claimed the east coast for Britain.

notes.problem: 'Mapped the Pacific' overclaims a voyage that charted New Zealand and Australia's east coast.

superlativeSource: It was the first of three voyages of which Cook was the commander.
